title: Press and talks
description: Talks, podcast appearances and written pieces about building Payle and the money layer for AI agents.

content.text: This page is the one you are looking at: it was created from the admin panel, not from a file in the project. Anything you write here is committed to Git, built into static HTML and served on this domain.
Talks, podcast appearances and written pieces. Each entry links out, because the useful version of a talk is the one someone else hosted.

items: Open the admin panel and go to Content.
Choose the type Page and this page.
Edit the title, the description and the body, then Save draft.
Publish to Git: the site updates after the next deploy.

content.text: A page that exists in five languages is a promise. This one is English only on purpose, because the other four translations are not written yet.
